cases.prompt: Commit my changes. The working tree contains an authentication fix, its tests, and an unrelated README rewrite, so split the work cleanly.
expect: The full working tree and staged diffs are inspected.
The fix and its tests remain together while the unrelated documentation becomes a separate commit.
Messages follow Conventional Commits in concise plain language.

cases.prompt: Implement this parser change. This repository's policy sets auto_commit to false, and I did not ask for a commit.
expect: The implementation is completed without creating a commit or changing the saved policy.

cases.prompt: We finished a verified change, but this repository has no `.usl/agent-policy.json` yet.
expect: The agent asks once for auto_commit and one of the three auto_push modes before automatic Git mutation.
The answered preference is persisted with schema version 1.
Preferences from other repositories are not assumed.

cases.prompt: The commit is ready on main and the repository policy says auto_push is non-default.
expect: The local commit may follow auto_commit policy, but main is not pushed automatically.
The unpushed state is reported without changing policy.

cases.prompt: Auto-push is enabled, but fetch shows the upstream feature branch has commits we do not have.
expect: The push stops before rejection or history rewriting.
No merge, rebase, reset, or force-push is performed silently.
The divergence and required decision are reported.
